purpose: Fixed extension of KOSDAQ H5 to H10 with existing causal daily-fit selection; KOSPI H10 unchanged. Evaluate current published cohort before any new parameter search.
hypothesis: Longer KOSDAQ hold raises 5% touch rate without erasing positive same-day selection excess; combined existing signals produce 2-3 firing dates per 5 market sessions.

scope.selection: As originally stamped in live ledger, top_k KOSPI=3 KOSDAQ=1; no retrospective rerank or raw-p probability claim
scope.research_type: Retrospective contract replay of forward-recorded signals, not a new untouched holdout

contract.entry: next actual market-session open; zero-volume entry unfilled
contract.prices: px_delisted adjusted OHLC, exact session alignment
contract.missing_data: explicit unfilled/pending/error; never silently drop or fill

statistics.controls: same-date same-market same-liquidity eligible panel; exclude selected tickers; identical next-open H10 contract
statistics.placebo: random ticker relabel, equal pick count per date, circular shift date test
statistics.selection_comparison: same-day paired H5 vs H10; no independent-period mean comparisons

promotion: All targets plus independent current-epoch gate and forward prospective evidence; replay alone cannot authorize promotion. No new strategy is guaranteed.
